findingDetails.title: Piped-report regression retains fleet naming after switching to a seeded single-package run
findingDetails.claim: The regression was moved from a whole-corpus --strict run to runCli(packageRoot, ['--strict']) over a fixture package seeded with 1500 unresolved paths, but the local binding fleet and both assertion messages still say fleet report, so a failure of the seeded run is reported as a fleet failure and points a maintainer at the corpus instead of the fixture.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Read both helpers (runCli uses spawnSync with captured stdio, so the pipe path is exercised) and the changelog entry, which documents the seeded-package shape; no comment declares the retained naming deliberate; assertion semantics themselves are correct.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: fleet could be read as a generic label for the report output, but both messages name the fleet specifically and the code no longer runs one.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Binding renamed and the two assertion messages reworded; test behavior unchanged.
findingDetails.recommendation: Rename the binding (package or seeded) and reword the two assertion messages to name the seeded report.
